title: A bounded-above finite-free model of a module complex glues from a finite standard-open cover
statement: Let $A$ be a ring and $M^\bullet$ a complex of $A$-modules. Let $f_1,\dots,f_n\in A$ generate the unit ideal, and suppose that for each $i$ the localized complex $M^\bullet_{f_i}=M^\bullet\otimes_AA_{f_i}$ is quasi-isomorphic to a bounded-above complex of finite free $A_{f_i}$-modules. Then $M^\bullet$ is quasi-isomorphic to a bounded-above complex of finite free $A$-modules.
